post.caption:
9 nights beside his hospital bed. Did Allah stop listening? 🤍

“Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].” (93:3)

He hears every dua, even the tired ones. Tonight after Maghrib, make dua for someone who's sick. 🤲

verses.text: “Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].”

captions: Ward 4. The monitor beeps. Your father sleeps.
“If He were listening, Dad would be home by now.”
Then his fingers move. He whispers: “Did you pray?”
The tap in the hallway. Cold water, slowly.
Maghrib on a folded towel, beside his bed.
And the dua comes back. Quietly. Word by word.
His hand in yours. You were never alone in this room.
